reason: The cited evidence (E2) states that Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation, improve oxidation resistance, and improve mechanical properties of transition metal borides, supporting the first three premises. However, the specific claims about a core–shell architecture enabling densification below 1700°C and forming a passivating borosilicate scale are not directly supported by the cited passages, which only discuss general additive effects.
premises: Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation of difficult-to-sinter boride powders
Si-containing additives improve oxidation resistance of boride-based ceramics
Si-containing additives improve mechanical properties of boride-based ceramics
A Si-rich shell can enable liquid-phase sintering below 1700°C
A Si-rich shell can evolve into a protective borosilicate passivation layer
